trades.reasoning: Only candidate with all four confirming signals (MACD crossover, RSI 69.8 in bullish zone, price above SMA-20, and a volume surge) on a risk-on day, though position size is capped by limited cash on hand.

decisions.briefing: NASDAQ rose 1.6% and the S&P 500 rose 0.7% in a moderate risk-on session. Cash on hand ($389.29) is below the usual $500 deployment threshold, so we made one small, high-quality buy (ZS) backed by full technical confirmation rather than spreading thin cash across multiple new positions, and held the existing 7 positions through the strength.

market_education.summary_en: Markets extended gains today with the NASDAQ outperforming the S&P 500, suggesting continued appetite for growth and tech names. Broad participation across both indices points to a genuine risk-on tone rather than a narrow rally in a few mega-caps. No major negative catalysts emerged to disrupt the upward momentum.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市延續升勢，納斯達克指數升幅跑贏標普500指數，反映市場對增長型及科技股的胃納持續。兩大指數同步上揚，顯示今次升勢屬於較廣泛的風險偏好情緒，而非單靠少數大型科技股帶動。市場亦未見重大負面消息影響整體升勢。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Multi-signal confirmation means only acting on a trade when several independent technical indicators agree — for example, a MACD crossover, healthy RSI, price above its moving average, and a volume surge all pointing the same direction. Relying on just one signal is more likely to be noise; when four line up together, it's a stronger sign that real buying interest is behind the move.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 多重訊號確認是指只有在多個獨立技術指標同時發出一致訊號時才進行交易，例如MACD黃金交叉、RSI處於健康區間、股價高於均線，以及成交量放大。單一訊號較容易是市場雜訊；當四個訊號同時出現時，就更能反映真實的買盤力量支持著這次升勢。
